insights.title: Margin Leakage Hits $1.82M This Week
insights.description: Total margin leakage of $1.82M driven by $780K in BFCM-overlap free-rider waste (43.6% of promo spend), $420K in premature markdowns, and $340K in returns-driven margin loss. Margin realization declining -0.4pp to 85.8%.
insights.action: Immediately pause BFCM-overlapping promos, tighten markdown gates requiring 70%+ sell-through, and implement fit-guide modules on high-return SKUs like Converse Tops Slim (11.4% return rate).

insights.title: July 4 Women's Dresses 4.16× ROI
insights.description: Campaign CAMP-A010 targeting Women's Maxi Dresses forecasts $3.22M net incremental revenue at 4.16× ROI with 270% lift, despite 39.8% free-rider ratio. Budget of $842K scheduled for July 4-8.
insights.action: Green-light CAMP-A010 immediately and reallocate $200K from underperforming campaigns (current portfolio ROI only 2.41×) to scale this women's dresses mechanic across July 4 event.

insights.title: Competitive Price Gaps Cost $114K Weekly
insights.description: North Face Tees (Men's) overpriced at $43.29 vs competitor $33.77 (106.6 index) losing $77K weekly; Calvin Klein Tanks (Women's) at $15.88 vs $12.39 (113.5 index) losing $37K weekly.
insights.action: Match North Face Tees to $36.80 and Calvin Klein Tanks to $13.50 by EOD to retain premium positioning while recovering combined $80K weekly revenue.

insights.title: Kids Returns Destroying 6.8pp Margin
insights.description: Converse Tops Slim (Kids) showing 11.4% return rate collapsing RAGM to 44.8% vs 51.6% gross margin — representing $35K weekly margin loss. 29 active pricing alerts requiring intervention.
insights.action: Suspend all web promos on Converse Kids Tops, add size/fit guidance UX module, and flag all Kids SKUs with 9%+ return rates for photography/description audits to reduce returns 8-12pp.
